test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: _______ is most common in industries like agriculture, tourism, hotel, catering, etc.
solution:
The correct answer is **Seasonal unemployment.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Seasonal Unemployment:**

 
 
• Seasonal unemployment occurs when people are unemployed at particular times of the year when demand for labor is lower than usual.
 
• This type of unemployment is common in industries like agriculture, tourism, hotel, and catering, where the demand for labor fluctuates with the seasons.
 
• For example, agricultural workers may be in high demand during planting and harvest seasons but may face unemployment during the off-season.
 
• Similarly, tourism-related jobs may surge during holiday seasons and decline during off-peak periods.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Structural Unemployment:**

 
 
• Structural unemployment occurs due to a mismatch between the skills of the workforce and the demands of the job market.
 
 
• **Cyclical Unemployment:**
 
 
• Cyclical unemployment is related to the economic cycle of boom and bust.
 
• During periods of economic downturn or recession, businesses reduce their workforce, leading to higher unemployment.
 
• This type of unemployment is not tied to specific seasons but rather the overall economic climate.
 
 
 
• **Frictional Unemployment:**
 
 
• Frictional unemployment occurs when people are temporarily unemployed while transitioning from one job to another.
 
• This type of unemployment is usually short-term and is a natural part of the job search process.
 
• It is not typically associated with seasonal industries.
